about: The cat roams: on its own wakes it goes up to the attic no exit reaches and comes back down, and the kitchen hears it go and come. The dog does not roam: its move to the attic faults out of range, its wake is spent, and the kitchen hears nothing. Nor may the cat carry the hay up: roaming takes the cat anywhere, and nothing it moves, so that move faults.

expect.words: The cat purrs, and eyes the ceiling.
A cat leaves for an attic.
A cat arrives from an attic.
The dog pricks up its ears.

expect.text: the wake of kitchen.dog faulted, against attic, NameOutOfRange: `roaming.attic` is out of range of `roaming.kitchen.dog`; a kind that `roams` may go there.

expect.words: Something in this world has gone wrong, and nothing has changed.

expect.text: the command faulted, against attic, MoveFault: `roaming.attic` is out of range of `roaming.kitchen.cat`, so nothing could be moved into it.
